summary.text: Wendell Gilliard is a Democratic business owner and former Charleston city councilman who has represented District 111 in the South Carolina House of Representatives since 2008, and he is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Wendell Gilliard graduated from Rivers High School in 1973 and attended Devry School of Technology for three years.
He also took political science training courses through United Steel Workers Union classes and the National League of Cities, which awarded him a bronze certificate in political science.

Gilliard is a former president of the United Steel Workers Local Union and a former chemical plant operator for Albright and Wilson Chemical Plant, and he later became the owner of WGG Consulting Company.
Gilliard served on the Charleston City Council before joining the House in 2008.
For 2025-2026 he is assigned to the Medical, Military, Public and Municipal Affairs Committee, on which he has served throughout his House tenure.
